def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # --- items of target products, purchased strictly before seed_time ---
    items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time]
    items = items[items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]

    # order-level info known at seed_time: purchase time always known;
    # approval / delivery dates only if they happened before seed_time
    ord_cols = orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp",
                       "order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
                       "order_delivered_customer_date",
                       "order_estimated_delivery_date"]].copy()
    for c in ["order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
              "order_delivered_customer_date"]:
        ord_cols.loc[ord_cols[c] >= seed_time, c] = pd.NaT

    io = items.merge(ord_cols, on="order_id", how="left")

    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")
    feat = pd.DataFrame(index=idx)

    # --- sales counts in windows ---
    ts = io["ts"]
    for w in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        cnt = io[ts >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)].groupby("product_id").size()
        feat[f"sales_last_{w}d"] = cnt.reindex(idx).fillna(0)

    # ratios of recent to older activity
    s30 = feat["sales_last_30d"]
    s90 = feat["sales_last_90d"]
    s180 = feat["sales_last_180d"]
    feat["sales_30_to_90"] = s90 - s30
    feat["sales_90_to_180"] = s180 - s90
    feat["sales_trend_30_90"] = s30 / (s90 + 1)
    feat["sales_trend_90_180"] = s90 / (s180 + 1)

    # --- lifetime aggregates ---
    if len(io) > 0:
        agg = io.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
            total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            max_price=("price", "max"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            first_ts=("ts", "min"),
            last_ts=("ts", "max"),
        )
        feat["total_sold"] = agg["total_sold"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["total_orders"] = agg["total_orders"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["total_revenue"] = agg["total_revenue"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["avg_price"] = agg["avg_price"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["max_price"] = agg["max_price"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["std_price"] = agg["std_price"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["total_freight"] = agg["total_freight"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["avg_freight"] = agg["avg_freight"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["freight_ratio"] = feat["total_freight"] / (feat["total_revenue"] + 1)
        feat["n_sellers"] = agg["n_sellers"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        feat["items_per_order"] = feat["total_sold"] / (feat["total_orders"] + 1)

        feat["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - agg["first_ts"].reindex(idx)).dt.days
        feat["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - agg["last_ts"].reindex(idx)).dt.days
        feat["days_since_first_sale"] = feat["days_since_first_sale"].fillna(9999)
        feat["days_since_last_sale"] = feat["days_since_last_sale"].fillna(9999)

        # sales in the 90 days right after first appearance (early momentum)
        first_map = agg["first_ts"].reindex(idx)
        early = io.merge(first_map.rename("ft").reset_index().rename(columns={"product_id": "product_id"}),
                         on="product_id", how="left")
        early_mask = (early["ts"] - early["ft"]) <= pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        early_cnt = early[early_mask].groupby("product_id").size()
        feat["sales_first_90d"] = early_cnt.reindex(idx).fillna(0)

        # distinct active months
        months = io.assign(m=io["ts"].dt.to_period("M")).groupby("product_id")["m"].nunique()
        feat["active_months"] = months.reindex(idx).fillna(0)

        # delivery performance (only deliveries completed before seed_time)
        delivered = io[io["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()].copy()
        if len(delivered) > 0:
            delivered["delay"] = (delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
                                  delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            delivered["ship_days"] = (delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
                                      delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            d = delivered.groupby("product_id").agg(
                n_delivered=("order_id", "count"),
                avg_delay=("delay", "mean"),
                late_rate=("delay", lambda x: (x > 0).mean()),
                avg_ship_days=("ship_days", "mean"),
            )
            feat["n_delivered"] = d["n_delivered"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
            feat["avg_delay"] = d["avg_delay"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
            feat["late_rate"] = d["late_rate"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
            feat["avg_ship_days"] = d["avg_ship_days"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
        else:
            feat["n_delivered"] = 0
            feat["avg_delay"] = 0
            feat["late_rate"] = 0
            feat["avg_ship_days"] = 0
        feat["deliver_ratio"] = feat["n_delivered"] / (feat["total_orders"] + 1)
    else:
        for c in ["total_sold", "total_orders", "total_revenue", "avg_price", "max_price",
                  "std_price", "total_freight", "avg_freight", "freight_ratio", "n_sellers",
                  "items_per_order", "days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale",
                  "sales_first_90d", "active_months", "n_delivered", "avg_delay",
                  "late_rate", "avg_ship_days", "deliver_ratio"]:
            feat[c] = 0

    # --- reviews: only those created before seed_time ---
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    prod_orders = io[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    rev_m = prod_orders.merge(rev, on="order_id", how="left")
    r = rev_m.groupby("product_id")["review_score"].agg(["mean", "count", "min", "max"])
    feat["avg_review_score"] = r["mean"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feat["review_count"] = r["count"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feat["min_review_score"] = r["min"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feat["max_review_score"] = r["max"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feat["review_coverage"] = feat["review_count"] / (feat["total_orders"] + 1)
    # share of bad reviews
    bad = rev_m[rev_m["review_score"] <= 2].groupby("product_id").size()
    feat["bad_review_rate"] = (bad.reindex(idx).fillna(0) / (feat["review_count"] + 1))

    # --- payments: known at purchase time (ts < seed_time already ensured via items) ---
    pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time][["order_id", "payment_installments",
                                                "payment_value", "payment_type"]]
    pay_m = prod_orders.merge(pay, on="order_id", how="left")
    p = pay_m.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
    )
    feat["avg_installments"] = p["avg_installments"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feat["avg_payment_value"] = p["avg_payment_value"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    feat["total_payment_value"] = p["total_payment_value"].reindex(idx).fillna(0)
    cc = pay_m[pay_m["payment_type"] == "credit_card"].groupby("product_id").size()
    feat["credit_card_share"] = cc.reindex(idx).fillna(0) / (feat["total_orders"] + 1)

    # --- seasonality of seed_time ---
    feat["seed_month"] = seed_time.month
    feat["seed_quarter"] = seed_time.quarter

    feat = feat.fillna(0).astype(float)
    feat = feat.reindex(entity_ids)
    return feat
